issues.concern: The top-level gloss is slightly incomplete and could be clearer for an intermediate learner.
issues.suggestion: Change 'future blessing (omikuji fortune level)' to 'future blessing (a fortune level on an omikuji, indicating good luck will come later)' or similar.

issues.concern: The English translation 'drew a future blessing' is a bit unnatural.
issues.suggestion: Change 'I drew a future blessing on the omikuji.' to 'I drew a suekichi (future blessing) on the omikuji.' or 'I got a suekichi (future blessing) on the omikuji.'

issues.concern: The English translation 'A future blessing means that now is a time for patience.' is a bit unnatural.
issues.suggestion: Change 'A future blessing means that now is a time for patience.' to 'A suekichi (future blessing) means that now is a time for patience.' or 'A suekichi means that you need to be patient now.'

issues.concern: The English translation 'I was a little disappointed to get a future blessing' is a bit unnatural.
issues.suggestion: Change 'I was a little disappointed to get a future blessing' to 'I was a little disappointed to get a suekichi (future blessing)' or 'I was a little disappointed to get a suekichi'.
